title.zh: 量测验证：怎样证明刻好了
title.en: Metrology validation: how to prove the etch is good

subtitle.zh: 尺寸、深度、均匀性、残留与电性。
subtitle.en: Dimensions, depth, uniformity, residue and electrical properties

body.zh: 核心判断；终点信号用于帮助停机；工艺合格还需要；刻后量测、缺陷检查及必要的电性验证。
body.en: Core assessment Endpoint signals help stop the process; qualification still requires post-etch metrology, defect inspection and necessary electrical validation

body.zh: 流程位置；连接刻蚀完成与下游放行，；也为异常分析提供反馈。
body.en: Position in the flow Connect etch completion to downstream release, while providing feedback for anomaly analysis

body.zh: 验证流程；核对进片基线
body.en: Validation flow Verify the incoming baseline

body.zh: 检查终点/时间；记录
body.en: Check endpoint/time records

body.zh: 测尺寸与深度
body.en: Measure dimensions and depth

body.zh: 查缺陷及必要；电性
body.en: Inspect defects and necessary electrical properties

body.zh: 按控制计划；放行或隔离分析
body.en: Release or isolate for analysis according to the control plan

body.zh: 关键指标；关键尺寸及侧壁；关键尺寸；侧壁
body.en: Key metrics Critical dimensions and sidewalls Critical dimension Sidewall

body.zh: 深度及剩余膜厚；剩余膜厚；深度
body.en: Depth and remaining film thickness Remaining film thickness Depth

body.zh: 片内/片间均匀性
body.en: Within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer uniformity

body.zh: 缺陷及电性；电性
body.en: Defects and electrical properties Electrical properties

body.zh: 方法与反馈；CD-SEM看关键尺寸；关键尺寸
body.en: Methods and feedback CD-SEM for critical dimensions Critical dimension

body.zh: 截面SEM看侧壁和底部；侧壁；底部
body.en: Cross-sectional SEM for sidewalls and bottom Sidewall Bottom

body.zh: 在适用区域用椭偏/反射；测厚或台阶量测
body.en: Use ellipsometry/reflectometry for thickness or step-height metrology in suitable regions

body.zh: 缺陷分布图结合统计过程；控制（SPC）识别漂移，；并复核机台、来料和量测系统。；反馈；到工艺条件
body.en: Combine defect maps with statistical process control (SPC) to detect drift, then recheck the tool, incoming wafers and metrology system Feed back to process conditions

body.zh: 耦合与失效；测得更多会增加检测成本，要兼顾；抽样覆盖。只看平均值可能漏掉边缘；异常，只看顶部尺寸可能漏掉底部；残留与缩口。
body.en: Coupling and failure More measurement raises inspection cost, so maintain adequate sampling coverage; averages can miss edge anomalies, while top dimensions alone can miss bottom residue and necking

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；有效验证能降低异常流入填充、；接触或后续沉积的风险。；OES光发射终点检测受开口面积和；信号强度影响；量测能力也受结构；尺寸、深宽比与光学模型限制。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries Effective validation reduces the risk of anomalies entering fill, contacts or subsequent deposition OES optical-emission endpoint detection depends on open area and signal strength; measurement capability is also limited by feature dimensions, aspect ratio and optical models

body.zh: 量测反馈；量测结果；（尺寸、深度、均匀性、；残留与电性）
body.en: Metrology feedback Measurement results (dimensions, depth, uniformity, residue and electrical properties)

body.zh: 放行；隔离分析
body.en: Release Isolation and analysis

body.zh: 反馈到工艺条件
body.en: Feed back to process conditions
